ask_the_analyst.description: Answer a natural-language analytics question by resolving it to one or more DECLARED metrics (seeded with the metrics.yml descriptions), then executing those metrics through the semantic layer and returning a grounded answer with the generated SQL. Use this for aggregate metric questions like 'what is our average interest rate?' — it will NOT return a single blended number; it returns each declared metric.

decimals.description: Optional fixed-decimal rounding for displayed numbers

question.description: Natural-language analytics question (e.g. 'what is our average interest rate?')

get_call_summary.description: Get a summary of a specific call by its ID.

query_csat.description: Query CSAT survey results from Postgres. Filter by score range or call category. Use this to understand member satisfaction trends.

category.description: Filter by call category (e.g. fraud_dispute, loan_inquiry)

query_metric.description: Query one or more DECLARED metrics from the MetricFlow semantic layer (olap/dbt/models/marts/semantic/metrics.yml) and return the result table plus the SQL the semantic layer generated. There is no bare ambiguous metric ('interest rate', 'balance', 'LCV'): resolve the word to its specific lob-qualified metric names first, e.g. average_mortgage_note_rate, average_deposit_apy, banking_available_balance, net_member_liquidity, member_lifetime_value.

decimals.description: Optional fixed-decimal rounding for displayed numbers

search_transcripts.description: Search call transcripts using natural language. Use this to find calls about specific topics, issues, or patterns. Examples: 'calls where members complained about fees', 'fraud disputes where the member was frustrated', 'calls that were escalated'.
